about: A chip of BN5's whose code moved into BN6's engine (issue #82's C3): BN5's CanladEX held paralysed (hold: each game's own status step, the same bits in both) at (3,2), on MegaMan's side of the field, where Slasher finds a foe (0x0800FEBC: a panel holding an enemy, not the enemy's side's), MegaMan at (1,2) with a folder of Slasher B in both games, BN5's chip 56 by BN5's own code and the registry's 431 by the same code moved (BN5's family 0x29 as BN6's 0x79; the family it starts on the player's flag 0x80000, BN5's 0x49, as BN6's 0x99), the first Custom screen's chip picked and OK, used at t30, its slash at once: every difference of BN6's play from BN5's fails it (docs/multirom/chips-code.md).
